format: Readable TWX script source; selected bytes copied unchanged.

inventory.selection: All readable .ts sources outside generated/build/runtime directories; .txt only when at least three TWX command/label lines are present; readable .ts.backup/.ts.msfucked source only when at least three TWX command/label lines are present.
excluded: Encrypted .cts files (observed TWX SCRIPT binary wrapper), .es files, and unreadable/mixed .ets files.
Unreadable binary .inc; help/manual/documentation .txt; configs/secrets; runtime status/log files; generated/build outputs (bin, obj, artifacts, logs, caches); unrelated languages and assets.
No script was run and no live game action was taken.

deduplication.method: Line-aware TWX token comparison: strip full-line # comments, ignore inter-token whitespace, fold unquoted tokens case-insensitively, preserve quoted literals and line boundaries.
deduplication.policy: One output per equivalent token stream. Every merged source path and SHA-256 remains in its output entry. Distinct token streams are retained; colliding basenames receive source-derived suffixes. This is source-level deduplication, not a runtime semantic-equivalence claim.
deduplication.variant_difference_measure: For same-basename retained variants, catalog records normalized statement-line counts, normalized token counts, and peer-only statement-line counts. This documents source-level differences, not a semantic or runtime assessment.
